svg.title: 42. Side lying open book — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Lie on your side with knees bent and stacked. Reach both arms forwards. Lift the top arm and turn your chest open as the arm moves behind you. Keep the knees together and return slowly.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.leedsth.nhs.uk/patients/resources/physiotherapy-exercises-for-breast-pain-with-chest-wall-musculoskeletal-symptoms/
